slices.focus: Board photo rule: both shifts photograph board at handoff for records.
slices.summary: After six weeks of the board pilot showing fewer unexplained late departures, Jae-hyun gets approval to require both shifts to photograph the board at handoff and save images to a nightly report folder. The photo requirement changes behavior upstream, with crews pausing longer at the board before calling handoff finished.
open_loops: Expanding photo rule beyond two test routes
decisions: Jae-hyun is still dispatch manager, but the two-route color-coded board pilot has expanded into a photo-documented hando
